description: This file defines a non-allocating stopwatch utility called ValueStopwatch used for high-resolution timing and duration measurement within the Orleans.Runtime namespace.

classes.name: ValueStopwatch
classes.description: A high-performance, non-allocating stopwatch for measuring elapsed time with methods to start, stop, restart, reset, and retrieve timing information.

methods.name: StartNew
methods.description: Creates and starts a new ValueStopwatch, optionally with an initial elapsed duration.

methods.name: FromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a stopped ValueStopwatch from specific start and end timestamps.

methods.name: GetTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp from the underlying hardware timer.

methods.name: GetRawTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the raw internal timestamp value for the stopwatch instance.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the stopwatch if it is not already running.

methods.name: Restart
methods.description: Restarts the stopwatch, beginning timing from zero.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch into a stopped state with no elapsed time.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and records the elapsed duration.
